title: Strict static XODR verification with evidence binding

defect_summary.no_xodr_hash_in_report: Both verify_final_xodr.py and preflight_xodr_loadability.py produced reports without recording the SHA256 of the XODR file they verified, making it impossible to detect if a report was swapped for a different XODR file.
defect_summary.no_report_self_hash: Reports had no self-referential SHA256, so a tampered report could not be detected.
defect_summary.no_provenance: Reports contained no tool version, git commit, or environment metadata, preventing forensic traceability.
defect_summary.no_evidence_schema: Reports lacked a versioned schema identifier, making forward/backward compatibility fragile.

corrected_semantics.verify_final_xodr: Adds xodr_sha256 (SHA256 of the verified XODR), provenance block (tool name, git SHA, Python version). Schema bumped to v1.
corrected_semantics.preflight_xodr_loadability: Adds xodr_sha256 (SHA256 of input XODR), report_sha256 (SHA256 of the written report for tamper detection), provenance block (tool name, git SHA, Python version). Schema bumped to v1.
corrected_semantics.both_tools: Reports now self-identify with schema version and include full provenance for forensic traceability. Report consumers can verify the report matches the XODR it claims to verify.

tests.coverage: All existing tests for verify_final_xodr (lane width scanning, junction/connector counting, parse error handling, dry-run invariant) and preflight_xodr_loadability (module integration, error aggregation, status determination) pass without modification.

residual_risks: Report consumers (e.g., final_map_readiness_gate) must opt-in to verify xodr_sha256; this was addressed in OC-41 but requires coordinated deployment.

preflight_xodr_loadability module results (strict_validator, carla_compat_gate, lane_section_successor_scan) don't individually include xodr_sha256; only the top-level report does. Sub-module results could be swapped independently.
Git SHA capture depends on git being available in the execution environment; falls back to empty string if unavailable.
